description: This file defines macros, data structures, and function prototypes for interfacing with the OA TC6 device over SPI, including register access, data transfer, and status checking.

classes.name: oa_tc6
classes.description: Structure representing the OA TC6 device state, including SPI interface, buffer sizes, status flags, and network buffer.

methods.name: oa_tc6_get_parity
methods.description: Calculates the parity bit of a 32-bit data word, returning 0 if the number of ones is odd, 1 otherwise.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the OA TC6 device via SPI.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the OA TC6 device via SPI.

methods.name: oa_tc6_set_protected_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables protected control mode on the OA TC6 device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_send_chunks
methods.description: Sends data chunks to the OA TC6 device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_read_chunks
methods.description: Reads data chunks from the OA TC6 device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_chunk_spi_transfer
methods.description: Performs SPI transfer of a single data chunk with headers and footers.

methods.name: oa_tc6_read_status
methods.description: Reads status information from the OA TC6 device.

methods.name: oa_tc6_reg_rmw
methods.description: Performs read-modify-write operation on a device register.

methods.name: oa_tc6_check_status
methods.description: Checks the operational status of the OA TC6 device.
